_comment: Cross-language EIP-712 test vector, derived from docs/eip712.json (the frozen spec).
Consumed by contracts/test/Eip712Parity.t.sol (forge), engine/tests (pytest, Phase 2) and
web (viem, Phase 3). If any two of those three disagree, this file says which layer diverged:
compare domainSeparator, then the per-fill struct hashes, then fillsArrayHash, then
batchStructHash, then digest. That turns a parity bug from an hour of bisecting into one diff.
The signing key is a PUBLIC TEST VECTOR, not a secret, and holds no funds on any network:
All three stacks use RFC 6979 deterministic nonces, so they must produce a BYTE-IDENTICAL
signature — the parity assertion is on the 65 bytes, not merely on the recovered address.
verifyingContract is a SENTINEL, deliberately not the live vault, so redeploying the vault
never stales this file. Regenerate with:
_notes: amountQuote values satisfy the frozen settlement formula at 6/6 decimals:
eth_account note: docs/eip712.json contains Order, Fill and Batch, and both Order and Batch are
unreferenced, so primary-type inference is ambiguous. Always pass a FILTERED types dict:
{'Batch': ..., 'Fill': ...} when signing batches, {'Order': ...} when verifying orders.
viem note: pass types WITHOUT EIP712Domain and set primaryType explicitly; numerics as bigint.
